capabilities.title: API & query
capabilities.summary: Minimal APIs and CRUD on Entity Framework Core — typed and dynamic builders, result caching with auto-invalidation, nested WhereClause filters, projection, property-level patch, bulk with per-item fallback, and CSV/XLSX/JSON export.

sections.title: What you get
items: **EF-backed CRUD** — `AddLyoQueryServices` / `AddLyoCrudServices` + `ApiEndpointBuilder` (typed) or `MapDynamicCrudEndpoints`
**Query engine** — nested And/Or `whereClause`, 16 comparators, includes, multi-sort, keys, `TotalCountMode`, optional in-memory `subClause`
**Projection** — sparse `QueryProject`, wildcards, SQL-level project when possible, computed SmartFormat columns
**Caching built in** — FusionCache / Lyo.Cache on Query + QueryProject; invalidate on Create/Update/Patch/Delete/Upsert
**Partial patch & bulk** — property-level Patch; bulk batch with individual fallback and partial success
**Delete / Upsert / Export** — delete by keys or WhereClause; upsert; CSV, XLSX, JSON export

capabilities.title: Jobs
capabilities.summary: A full job platform: PostgreSQL persistence, schedule evaluation, RabbitMQ-triggered workers, retries/SLA, alerts, SignalR fan-out, and MudBlazor management UI.

sections.title: End-to-end pipeline
items: **Definition** — `JobDefinitionBuilder`: worker type, parameters, retries, SLA, alerts, blackout calendar
**Schedule** — cron / interval / one-shot via `JobScheduleBuilder`, misfire policies, workflows
**Scheduler** — polls definitions, creates `JobRun` rows (`Queued`), publishes MQ triggers
**Worker** — `JobWorkerBase` claims run → heartbeat/progress → `ExecuteAsync` → `Finished`
**Events** — `IJobEventPublisher` on `job.events`
**Alerts & UI** — webhook/notification consumers + SignalR `JobHub` + `JobManagement` grids

capabilities.title: Reporting
capabilities.summary: Composable report models, PostgreSQL persistence, multi-format generation (HTML/PDF/CSV/XLSX/JSON), concurrency throttling, retention cleanup, and MudBlazor management.

sections.title: Pipeline
items: **Definition** — saved composition + parameters (`ReportDefinition`)
**Generate** — merge params, optional data provider, render via `IReportRenderer`
**Hooks** — persist staged files in `AfterRenderAsync`; delete on `OnCleanupAsync`
**Hardening** — ad-hoc generate gate, max concurrent generations (`ReportBusyException` → 503), retention
**API + UI** — `BuildReportingGroup` + Blazor reporting components

capabilities.title: File system watcher
capabilities.summary: Snapshot-based monitoring with debouncing and hash-based move/rename detection — more dependable than raw OS FileSystemWatcher events alone.

sections.title: Why it exists
items: Snapshot diffs catch missed or coalesced OS events
Debounce batches rapid create/write storms
Content hashing detects moves/renames when the FS does not
Separate file vs directory events; thread-safe; cancelable

capabilities.title: Temp IO
capabilities.summary: Session-scoped scratch files with cleanup policies.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.text: Avoid ad-hoc Path.GetTempFileName leaks. Sessions enforce naming, track bytes, overflow policies, and clean up on dispose — with optional auto-cleanup hosted service and in-memory storage for tests/WASM.

capabilities.title: Platform
capabilities.summary: Cache, locks, privacy, resilience, diagnostics, MQ, auth.

sections.title: Surfaces
items: **Cache** — Local and Fusion-backed ICacheService, typed byte payloads, query cache tags
**Locks** — Local and Redis locks plus keyed semaphores
**Privacy** — Redaction presets for text/JSON before logs leave the process
**Resilience** — Configuration-driven Polly pipelines
**Diagnostics** — Stack decoding, breadcrumbs, error inbox
**Message queue** — IMqService with RabbitMQ, delayed/priority helpers
**Auth** — JWKS, token endpoints, optional OIDC BFF
